create_HunyuanVideoModelSpecification: create a HunyuanVideoModelSpecification instance to load HunyuanVideo diffusion model components
build_HunyuanLatentEncodeProcessor: build a HunyuanLatentEncodeProcessor to encode image or video tensors into VAE latents
load_condition_models: load condition models including tokenizers and text encoders for HunyuanVideo
load_latent_models: load the VAE latent model for encoding video into latent space
load_diffusion_models: load the transformer and flow matching scheduler for HunyuanVideo diffusion
